title: Find function calls and text anywhere in a Gemini response's parts

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1060] Find `functionCall` and text parts anywhere in a `GoogleGeminiResponse`, so a tool call that follows text is run instead of ending the `Langchain::Assistant` run, a text part after a call no longer raises `NoMethodError`, and `chat_completion` joins every text part and leaves out thought summaries.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1058] Pass Anthropic `thinking` and `redacted_thinking` blocks back, first and unchanged, in the assistant turn of `Langchain::Assistant`'s tool-use loop; dropping them made the request carrying the tool result fail whenever Claude thought before calling a tool.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1059] Give a streamed `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic` tool call without arguments `input: {}` instead of `nil`, which made `Langchain::Assistant` end the run in `:failed` with streaming on.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1057] Rebuild `thinking` and `redacted_thinking` blocks in streamed `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#chat` responses instead of leaving `nil` in the content, which made `chat_completion` raise `NoMethodError` whenever Claude thought (by default on Claude 5 models).

@@ -6,22 +6,21 @@ def initialize(raw_response, model: nil)
       super
     end
 
+    # The model's answer, from every text part. A function call or a thought summary (`"thought": true`)
+    # can come before the text, and a long answer can be split over several text parts.
     def chat_completion
-      raw_response.dig("candidates", 0, "content", "parts", 0, "text")
+      texts = parts.select { |part| part.key?("text") && !part["thought"] }.map { |part| part["text"] }
+      texts.join unless texts.empty?
     end
 
     def role
       raw_response.dig("candidates", 0, "content", "role")
     end
 
+    # The function call parts, wherever they are. The model often explains what it's about to do in a
+    # text part before the call.
     def tool_calls
-      parts = raw_response.dig("candidates", 0, "content", "parts")
-
-      if parts&.first.is_a?(Hash) && parts.first.key?("functionCall")
-        parts
-      else
-        []
-      end
+      parts.select { |part| part.key?("functionCall") }
     end
 
     def embedding
@@ -47,5 +46,11 @@ def completion_tokens
     def total_tokens
       raw_response.dig("usageMetadata", "totalTokenCount")
     end
+
+    private
+
+    def parts
+      Array(raw_response.dig("candidates", 0, "content", "parts")).grep(Hash)
+    end
   end
 end

@@ -14,6 +14,38 @@
     it "returns role" do
       expect(response.role).to eq("model")
     end
+
+    it "joins the text parts when the model splits its answer" do
+      raw = {"candidates" => [{"content" => {"role" => "model", "parts" => [{"text" => "The answer "}, {"text" => "is 4.0"}]}}]}
+
+      expect(described_class.new(raw).chat_completion).to eq("The answer is 4.0")
+    end
+
+    it "returns the text that comes after a function call" do
+      raw = {"candidates" => [{"content" => {"role" => "model", "parts" => [
+        {"functionCall" => {"name" => "calculator__execute", "args" => {"input" => "2+2"}}},
+        {"text" => "Let me calculate that."}
+      ]}}]}
+
+      expect(described_class.new(raw).chat_completion).to eq("Let me calculate that.")
+    end
+
+    it "leaves out thought summaries" do
+      raw = {"candidates" => [{"content" => {"role" => "model", "parts" => [
+        {"text" => "**Adding the numbers**", "thought" => true},
+        {"text" => "The answer is 4.0", "thoughtSignature" => "c2ln"}
+      ]}}]}
+
+      expect(described_class.new(raw).chat_completion).to eq("The answer is 4.0")
+    end
+
+    it "returns nil when there is no text" do
+      raw = {"candidates" => [{"content" => {"role" => "model", "parts" => [
+        {"functionCall" => {"name" => "calculator__execute", "args" => {"input" => "2+2"}}}
+      ]}}]}
+
+      expect(described_class.new(raw).chat_completion).to be_nil
+    end
   end

       expect(response.tool_calls).to eq([{"functionCall" => {"name" => "calculator__execute", "args" => {"input" => "2+2"}}}])
     end
 
+    it "returns a function call that follows text" do
+      call = {"functionCall" => {"name" => "calculator__execute", "args" => {"input" => "2+2"}}, "thoughtSignature" => "c2ln"}
+      raw = {"candidates" => [{"content" => {"role" => "model", "parts" => [{"text" => "Let me calculate that."}, call]}}]}

+      expect(described_class.new(raw).tool_calls).to eq([call])

+      second = {"functionCall" => {"name" => "calculator__execute", "args" => {"input" => "3+3"}}}
+      raw = {"candidates" => [{"content" => {"role" => "model", "parts" => [first, {"text" => "Calculating."}, second]}}]}
+
+      expect(described_class.new(raw).tool_calls).to eq([first, second])
+    end
